info.text:
A $6 coffee. A 50% tip button.

Square's optional Smart tip setting shows $1, $2 or $3 on sales under $10; on $6 that's about 17%, 33% or 50%.
72% of US adults told Pew (2023) tipping is expected in more places than five years earlier.
Yet Toast's average quick-service tip slipped from 17.0% (Q1 2022) to 15.8% (Q1 2026).
Bankrate (2025): 27% tip less or nothing with a preset tip screen; 11% tip more.

Sources: Square; Pew Research Center; Toast; Bankrate; US Dept of Labor.
News and education, not financial advice.
